title: The Green Lotus Core Flame Is Refined
summary: Xiao Yan pulls the Flame Seed out of the Green Lotus Core Flame and swallows it, guided by Yao Lao. He nearly loses himself in the pain until memories of Nalan Yanran's challenge keep him going, and he drives the seed into his Acceptance Soul. The refining works, his injuries heal, and he reaches Four-Star Dou Shi. In Rock Desert City, the Sand Mercenary Company kidnaps Qing Lin and surrounds the Desert Metal Mercenary Company, backed by a new Da Dou Shi. Xiao Yan tries to forge the Green Lotus Core Flame into the Flame Mantra, which he must do for Yao Lao to be reborn. When the flame fights back, Yao Lao admits he first took him as a disciple only to absorb his Dou Qi. Yao Lao holds the flame with his own soul, and the Flame Mantra rises to Xuan Class Medium Rank.
events: Xiao Yan swallows the Flame Seed and fights the burning pain.
Memories of Nalan Yanran and the Three-year Agreement keep him going; he moves the seed into the Acceptance Soul.
He succeeds and reaches Four-Star Dou Shi.
At Rock Desert City, Qing Lin is kidnapped and the Sand Mercenary Company surrounds the Desert Metal compound.
Xiao Yan forges the Green Lotus Core Flame into the Flame Mantra; the flame resists.
Yao Lao confesses he first wanted only Xiao Yan's Dou Qi, and risks his soul to help.
The Flame Mantra rises from Huang Class to Xuan Class Medium Rank.
Two months remain before the Three-year Agreement; next they go to Hai Bodong with the Sand's Datura.
cultivation: Xiao Yan rises to Four-Star Dou Shi after refining the Green Lotus Core Flame (418.9). The Flame Mantra rises to Xuan Class Medium Rank (ep29.en.srt 96).
